import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long x, y, n;
    static long mna = -1, mnb = -1;

    static void calc(long a, int b) {
        if (a < 0) {
            return;
        }
        if (mna == -1) {
            mna = a;
            mnb = b;
            return;
        }
        long diff1 = Math.abs(mnb * x - mna * y) * b;
        long diff2 = Math.abs(b * x - a * y) * mnb;
        if (diff1 > diff2) {
            mna = a;
            mnb = b;
        } else if (diff1 == diff2 && (b < mnb || (b == mnb && a < mna))) {
            mna = a;
            mnb = b;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        x = sc.nextLong();
        y = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextLong();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long cur = i * x / y;
            long a = cur - 1;
            calc(a, i);
            a = cur;
            calc(a, i);
            a = cur + 1;
            calc(a, i);
        }
        System.out.println(mna + "/" + mnb);
        sc.close();
    }
}
